2608.07759.title: CFD-Guided Detection of Concept Drift in Multimodal Physiologic Signals
2608.07759.paper_summary: Cardiovascular AI models can classify clean elec- trocardiogram (ECG) signals, but real wearable signals change because of motion, breathing, posture, sensor contact, and true clinical deterioration. This paper asks when a model should keep its prediction, change it, or flag uncertainty. We propose a physiologic stability framework, called PECS, that compares changes inside the model with measurable changes in the signal. ECG is treated as the main cardiac signal, photoplethysmography (PPG) adds pulse and vascular information, and respiration is used only when ECG and PPG disagree. We test the framework on PTB-XL at pilot and full scales and on synchronized BIDMC and MIMIC waveform cohorts. The PTB-XL pilot and full- scale analyses selected different domain pairs, and the strongest cross-modal pair also changed across BIDMC and MIMIC, showing that adding every available signal is not always the best choice. PECS outperformed the evaluated drift-detection baseline implementations, reaching drift classification accuracy (DCA) of 0.8786 on expanded BIDMC and 0.9560 on MIMIC. The MIMIC results also showed that respiration can help during disagreement cases, but it should be used selectively rather than as an automatic override. Overall, the results support PECS as a candidate monitoring framework for wearable cardiovascular AI while highlighting the need for scale-aware domain selection and interpretable trust routing
2608.07759.paper_summary_zh: 心血管 AI 模型可以對乾淨的心電圖 (ECG) 信號進行分類，但實際的可穿戴信號因運動、呼吸、姿勢、傳感器接觸和真正的臨床惡化而變化。本文探討模型應在何時保持預測、改變預測或標記不確定性。我們提出了一個生理穩定性框架，稱為 PECS，該框架將模型內部的變化與信號中的可測量變化進行比較。ECG 被視為主要的心臟信號，光電容積描記法 (PPG) 添加了脈搏和血管信息，而呼吸僅在 ECG 和 PPG 不一致時使用。我們在 PTB-XL 的試點和全規模以及同步的 BIDMC 和 MIMIC 波形隊列上測試了該框架。PTB-XL 的試點和全規模分析選擇了不同的領域對，而最強的跨模態對在 BIDMC 和 MIMIC 之間也有所改變，顯示並非每個可用信號的添加都是最佳選擇。PECS 的表現超過了評估的漂移檢測基線實現，在擴展的 BIDMC 上達到 0.8786 的漂移分類準確率 (DCA)，在 MIMIC 上達到 0.9560。MIMIC 的結果還顯示，在不一致的情況下，呼吸可以提供幫助，但應該選擇性使用，而不是作為自動覆蓋。總體而言，結果支持 PECS 作為可穿戴心血管 AI 的候選監測框架，同時強調了對於規模感知的領域選擇和可解釋的信任路由的需求。
